original_test_intent: Run NVIDIA NVQual Test #21 to exercise the intended BlueField PCIe interface traffic path and verify every required test item passes on the approved endpoint/network topology.
original_method: An authorized operator pins the licensed NVQual build and Test #21 manifest, maps BlueField endpoints/root ports and traffic peers, runs the vendor procedure under PCIe/link/thermal monitoring, preserves every result and restores the topology.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the licensed Test #21 procedure and isolated PCIe/network topology; an authorized operator stages peers, launches the pinned workload, monitors endpoint/link health and reviews all items.
required_inputs: NVQual package/version/hash, license and Test #21 document revision
Resolved Test #21 item manifest and exact supported launcher/options
BlueField PCI BDF, root port, PF/VF, NUMA and firmware/driver mapping
Peer adapters/hosts, ports, cables/transceivers and network configuration
Expected PCIe generation/width and link recovery behavior
Traffic profile, payload integrity, rate, duration and all-item thresholds
AER/DPC/retrain, packet error, thermal/power and timeout aborts
Secure access, independent console, storage and topology restoration
safety_requirements: Do not infer the missing Test #21 command from nvqual -h
Never expose passwords or disable host-key verification
Isolate and authorize all endpoints and protect management/recovery paths
Record the exact PCIe endpoint before traffic; do not assume enumeration order
Stop on unexpected retrain/downtraining, AER/DPC, peer or packet/data-integrity error, thermal/power breach or console loss
No automatic retry because a rerun can erase transient link evidence
agent_execution_scope: Verify package, manifest, endpoint and topology identities
Preflight isolation, monitoring, storage and recovery readiness
Parse full per-item results and correlate AER/link/traffic evidence
Perform no install, topology change, traffic launch, link reset, retry or verdict without approval
engineer_actions: Provide licensed package and authoritative Test #21 command/manifest
Approve endpoints, topology, traffic limits and abort/recovery plan
Define all-items denominator and skip/error policy
Review complete item/link/restoration evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The help probe confirms neither Test #21 availability nor execution and is malformed/insecure. The exact traffic command must remain vendor-supplied.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the pinned vendor Test #21 launcher only after binding its manifest to named BlueField PCIe endpoints and peers; retain complete results and synchronized link/AER evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BlueField PCIe Interface Traffic Test #21, all-items criterion and 15/300-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: PACKAGE-GATED BLUEFIELD PCIE TRAFFIC QUALIFICATION WITH ENDPOINT-BOUND TELEMETRY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a run manifest that binds each Test #21 item to BDF/root port/PF/VF, peer and traffic parameters; continuously capture PCIe link status, AER/DPC and payload integrity through execution and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable endpoint identity, measurable traffic/integrity limits, synchronized PCIe error evidence and recovery without modifying the vendor test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: ConnectX EOM, binary help and generic network traffic do not replace the named Test #21 PCIe-interface workload.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: High traffic can expose transient retrains or AER events that disappear after reset or rerun. Aggregate throughput alone may remain acceptable through a downtrained link, so generation/width and error chronology must be part of acceptance.

project_override_considerations: If a documented Test #21 item is unsupported by a specific BlueField mode, record the exact mode/item exclusion and vendor authority; do not substitute NT.1 EOM or silently remove it from the denominator.
expected_evidence: NVQual/Test #21 package, license, document and resolved-manifest hashes
BlueField BDF/root-port/PF/VF/firmware-driver and peer/cable topology map
Per-item launcher, stdout/stderr, exit code, traffic integrity/throughput and timestamps
Pre/during/post PCIe generation/width, AER/DPC/retrain and peer/link health
Independent all-item calculation, no-hidden-skip/no-auto-retry audit, restored topology and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently identifies BlueField PCIe Interface Traffic Test #21 and requires all items passed. Missing command/manifest/topology are readiness dependencies rather than contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation and target are identifiable; execution is package/topology-gated and can proceed after the authoritative Test #21 procedure and approved endpoints are supplied.

review_improvement: Turns a help-only partial proposal into a secure endpoint-specific traffic qualification with full item accounting and transient PCIe fault preservation.
independent_technical_reasoning: PCIe traffic success cannot be inferred solely from network throughput because the endpoint may retrain to a narrower or slower link and continue passing packets. Test #21 evidence must bind payload integrity and performance to the same BDF/root port while preserving AER/DPC chronology. That makes this case distinct from ConnectX EOM and prevents a generic NVQual success banner from masking endpoint-specific degradation.
